results.overview: A youth named Diego (David Chocarro) was released from prison, 20 years after being incarcerated. He was unjustly accused of a school massacre. Soon after his release, he finds himself entangled in a series of conspiracies and intrigues. With the help of his psychiatrist, Antonia(Maritza Rodriguez), he begins to uncover the mysteries surrounding the massacre.
results.name: Facing Destiny

results.original_name: ディープリベンジ-顔を捨てた家政婦-
results.overview:
The protagonist, Nozomi, was on the peak of happiness after conceiving a child with her husband, Ryoichi, but she was involved in an accident whilst on holiday.

When she next awoke, she was told that the baby she was carrying had been stillborn, and that four years had passed.
results.name: Deep Revenge
